verdict.rationale: Orama documents official SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Rust, and a runtime probe confirms the JS SDK genuinely works end-to-end (create/insert/search) in-process, supporting AI-native workflows like vector/hybrid search, embeddings, and MCP-server integration for agents/ChatGPT/Cursor. Missing for 10: independent third-party validation of the Python/Rust SDKs and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found no openapi.json).
